source_note: This placement layer classifies first-order fusion/fission boundaries from activation shapes, role ownership, AM020-class tile memory, DMA channels, and neighbor sharing. It does not claim final timing, program-memory, register-pressure, or compiler-schedule viability.

notes: Neighbor sharing is a data-movement path; it does not increase local compute-tile or memory-tile capacity.
A same-role placement decision means the stages should be scheduled near each other. It does not mean their spatial kernels can ignore intermediate halo needs.
This model intentionally ignores final latency and instruction-memory pressure until generated MLIR/xclbin evidence is available.

spatial2col.reason: The two-column macro-lane remains useful for compile diagnostics, but it is not the product placement. Stage1->Stage2 needs a producer-owned C16 row-major activation ring; coupling ingress, SkipA, SkipB, and egress into two memory-tile roles leaves too little clean placement margin.

memory_tile_pressure.risk: front C16 halo ingress and long-lived SkipA delay share one physical memory tile
SkipB delay and final C16 egress share one physical memory tile

spatial2col.drop_condition: keep selectable for small compile proofs and scalar/vector audits; do not use as the canonical product profile for producer-ring work.

spatial4col.reason: The four-column macro-lane gives separate memory-tile roles for ingress/front C16 producer rings, SkipA, SkipB/transition staging, and egress. That is the physical placement needed for Stage1->Stage2 producer-owned row-major activation rings without DDR spill.

memory_tile_pressure.risk: normal front halo ingress pressure only
SkipA delay plus neighbor traffic toward decoder path
SkipB delay plus C32/C64 transition adjacency

spatial4col.promote_condition: already promoted for product work; keep measuring against 2col diagnostics when useful.

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 2 needs a C16 halo of Stage 1 output. Monolithic fusion requires Stage 1 to compute an expanded intermediate footprint.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: keep stage1_convnext16 and stage2_convnext16 as separate resident records until expanded-footprint fusion is proven

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 3 changes C16 to C32 and should not be hidden inside packing logic.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: stage3 may split out of the provisional stage3_4_down_fnb32 group

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 5 needs a C32 halo of Stage 4 output. Local scheduling is likely useful, but blind fusion would be incorrect.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: keep stage4 and stage5 records independently addressable

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 6 changes C32 to C64 and feeds the highest-pressure bottleneck channel count.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: stage6 may split out of the provisional stage6_7_down_fnb64 group

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 8 needs a C64 halo of Stage 7 output; C64 halo elements are large enough that depth should stay one until measured.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: stage7 and stage8 records must remain independently placeable

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 10 needs a C32 halo of Stage 9 output. This may be profitable if CT2D emits the needed halo chunks directly.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: stage9 CT2D/SkipB records and stage10 FNB32 records must remain independently addressable

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 12 needs a C16 halo of Stage 11 output. Fusion is possible only if Stage 11 emits an expanded C16 footprint or the tile materializes an internal halo view.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: stage11 and stage12 records stay separate until decoder fusion is measured

role_fusion_groups.reason: Stage 12 should eventually write the public m4x8 C16 egress layout directly unless a helper tile improves egress DMA scheduling.
role_fusion_groups.parameter_implication: no model parameters expected for egress_pack

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 2 requires a C16 halo of Stage 1 output.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: separate resident records; do not merge stage1/stage2 packing yet

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 2 emits SkipA and Stage 3 changes C16 to C32.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage3 owns a transition record independent of stage2

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 4 requires a C32 halo of Stage 3 output.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: provisional group stage3_4_down_fnb32 should remain splittable

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 5 requires a C32 halo of Stage 4 output.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage4 and stage5 records stay independent

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 5 emits SkipB and Stage 6 changes C32 to C64.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage6 owns a transition record independent of stage5

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 7 requires a C64 halo of Stage 6 output; C64 halo pressure is high.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: provisional group stage6_7_down_fnb64 should remain splittable

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 8 requires a C64 halo of Stage 7 output; keep depth one unless measured otherwise.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage7 and stage8 records stay independent

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 9 is a C64-to-C32 CT2D/SkipB join and should remain a decoder transition boundary.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage9 owns CT2D and SkipB join records

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 10 requires a C32 halo of Stage 9 output.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage9 and stage10 records stay independent until CT2D halo emission is proven

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 11 is a C32-to-C16 CT2D/SkipA join and consumes long-lived SkipA.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage11 owns CT2D and SkipA join records

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Stage 12 requires a C16 halo of Stage 11 output.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: stage11 and stage12 records stay independent until decoder fusion is measured

boundary_decisions.defer_reason: Keep egress_pack only if it improves DMA scheduling or isolates egress pressure.
boundary_decisions.parameter_implication: no extra resident model record for egress_pack

next_decisions.reason: The Stage1+2 -> Stage3/4 carrier compiles cleanly. The product implementation now needs the same Stage2-output tensor window backed by worker-local memory-tile ring shards with a production-time SkipA tee.

next_decisions: Implement the Stage1->Stage2 producer ring inside a single four-column worker first; npu1 has exactly one worker and must not require a peer worker.
Use auto worker groups only to instantiate independent copies of the same four-column worker on wider devices; split frame ownership, but do not introduce frame-hot cross-worker dependencies.
Keep spatial2col selectable for compile diagnostics only; product ring and skip planning targets spatial4col.
Implement the Stage2->Stage3/4 ring as worker-local memory-tile row shards; tee SkipA on Stage2 row production and treat eviction as slot reuse.
Measure the spatial4col on-chip ring path against DDR spill before making the DDR fallback permanent.
Keep stage3_4_down_fnb32 and stage6_7_down_fnb64 splittable until compile/timing evidence proves the fused paths are better.

worker_group_contract.auto_semantics: instantiate as many independent four-column workers as fit and split frame stripes between them
worker_group_contract.guard_policy: each worker owns or redundantly computes any horizontal guard columns it needs inside its own four-column placement; true frame edges use the explicit boundary contract
